adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (diff shows `: null` in the ternary around lines ~1060-1067). Later, for collective team events, the code attempts `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional chain prevents the push, so collected hosts' `teamDestinationCalendars` are dropped. This is directly verifiable from the diff and matches the finding's described edge case.
